rows.desktop_responsibility: Declare the Desktop mime-types lookup contract used by TypeScript: filename/path extension lookup returns a MIME string or false when unknown.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: TypeScript callers can type-check MIME lookup before attachment/media handling without inventing an unsafe MIME value.
rows.ios_platform_delta: The ambient TypeScript declaration itself is not portable; iOS has a native typed replacement using UniformTypeIdentifiers. IOSMimeTypes.lookup(path:) derives UTType from the filename extension and returns preferredMIMEType or nil when unknown, preserving the fail-closed optional result.
rows.production_evidence: source/mime-types.types.swift defines IOSMimeTypes.lookup(path:) with UniformTypeIdentifiers and is included in the shipping iOS project source list.
rows.test_evidence: Exact-head build/architecture Actions pending; caller-specific attachment/media tests cover MIME-sensitive paths.
rows.notes: Current Desktop 8148bfb9 declaration reviewed. This row maps the type/lookup contract to the native iOS utility, not to a fake Node module.
